title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode23 Your Music

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu. Are you back to write more songs?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No. I came to give you one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A song?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah. It's for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You came to give me a song?
Is that what you have in your hand?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, this sheet music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It feels...a little less lonely than before.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Less lonely?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. All of your music has sounded very lonely up until now...but this is different.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No one has ever said that about my music before...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This must be the sound of the new you, then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The new me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know about that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
I've decided to take a break from OWN.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah. Kanade says she's going to write me a song that will save me, so I've decided to write music with her for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So for now, that song I just gave you will be the last song I write as OWN.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well, I should be getting back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, there she is! Mafuyu's over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, would you stop running off by yourself?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm tired. Mizuki, you're too fast.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can go even faster when I really want to!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought this place got noisy all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It seems everybody has come to visit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heya, Miku! How are you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We hadn't really planned on coming here today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But when you didn't log on to Nightcord at the usual time, Mizuki said we should come looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, even you were like, Oh, I hope she hasn't gone off on her own again... You were just as worried as me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I said that, but I wasn't really that worried about her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Regardless, I'm glad we found you so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (No matter where Mafuyu goes from now on, Kanade and the others will be sure to find her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu wrote a song for me, so she came to let me listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She did? No fair! I want to hear it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure. I'd like everyone to hear it.
And afterward, I'd like to sing it with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: With all of us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's a great idea. Sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You mean me, too? I'm not really in the mood to sing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, don't say that! Come on, Ena! Let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hey! Don't just grab me like that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You too, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If even I have to sing, it would be weird if the person who wrote the thing not join in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't think that's true.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come on, less talking, more singing! Come on, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We haven't sung together since last time we were all here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. It was fun then, too! Right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, then. Let's all sing together.
